scripts.infra:up: docker rm -f mini-news-portal-db mini-news-portal-qdrant mini-news-portal-redis mini-news-portal-mailpit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker compose up -d --force-recreate --remove-orphans postgres redis
scripts.infra:up:rollback: docker rm -f mini-news-portal-db mini-news-portal-qdrant mini-news-portal-redis mini-news-portal-mailpit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker compose --profile rollback up -d --force-recreate --remove-orphans postgres qdrant redis
scripts.infra:down: docker compose down --remove-orphans; docker rm -f mini-news-portal-db mini-news-portal-qdrant mini-news-portal-redis mini-news-portal-mailpit >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
scripts.ai:models:pull: ollama pull bge-m3 && ollama pull qwen2.5:7b-instruct && ollama pull qwen2.5:3b-instruct
scripts.stack:up: pnpm infra:down && pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:migrate && (pnpm dev & pnpm worker:up & wait)
scripts.stack:up:rollback: pnpm infra:down && pnpm infra:up:rollback && pnpm db:migrate && (pnpm dev & pnpm worker:up & wait)
